2607.18098.title: VDAR-Router: Adaptive LLMs Routing via Verbalized Query Difficulty Analysis Retrieval
2607.18098.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly used in practical systems, making efficient model selection important for reducing deployment cost. LLM routing has emerged as a practical solution for allocating each input query to an appropriate model under a desired cost-performance trade-off. Existing routing methods often estimate model suitability from the surface semantics or embedding similarity of the input query. However, such methods may ignore the underlying difficulty of a query, leading to suboptimal routing decisions. To address the challenge, we propose VDAR-Router, a difficulty-aware retrieval-based routing framework. For each input query, VDAR-Router first generates an explicit difficulty analysis. It then retrieves historical examples with similar difficulty profiles. Based on the retrieved records, it estimates candidate model suitability and selects the model using a reward function that considers both performance and cost. Experiments on three datasets show that VDAR-Router consistently achieves better cost-performance trade-offs than existing baselines. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of difficulty-aware retrieval for training-free LLM routing. Case studies further show that explicit query analysis helps retrieve more relevant examples and supports more reliable routing decisions.
2607.18098.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型在實際系統中的應用越來越廣泛，使得有效的模型選擇對於降低部署成本變得重要。LLM 路由作為一種實用的解決方案，旨在在所需的成本-性能權衡下，將每個輸入查詢分配給適當的模型。現有的路由方法通常從輸入查詢的表面語義或嵌入相似性來估計模型的適用性。然而，這些方法可能忽略查詢的潛在難度，導致次優的路由決策。為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了 VDAR-Router，一種基於難度感知的檢索路由框架。對於每個輸入查詢，VDAR-Router 首先生成明確的難度分析。然後，它檢索具有相似難度特徵的歷史範例。根據檢索到的記錄，它估計候選模型的適用性，並使用考慮性能和成本的獎勵函數選擇模型。在三個數據集上的實驗顯示，VDAR-Router 始終實現了比現有基準更好的成本-性能權衡。這些結果證明了難度感知檢索在無需訓練的 LLM 路由中的有效性。案例研究進一步顯示，明確的查詢分析有助於檢索更相關的範例，並支持更可靠的路由決策。
